observerEffect.note: Wall-clock delta is bracketed by two no-audit score-only runs to expose observer effect; it is not treated as exact causal decomposition.

ancestryValidation.authority: direct original-node parent-chain traversal; propagated lineage is diagnostic only

knownTarget.interpretation: The prior isolated continuation proves counterfactual value-to-go, but in the full common-horizon search this rescued ancestry is eliminated by a later retention before reaching a terminal.

classificationSemantics.type0: common horizon applied but retained node set is identical to baseline
classificationSemantics.type1: retention changed but no newly retained ancestry survives at least two later retention rounds or reaches final front
classificationSemantics.type2: retention changed and newly retained ancestry survives at least two later retention rounds but reaches no final front node
classificationSemantics.type3: retention changed and newly retained ancestry reaches a final terminal Pareto-front node
classificationSemantics.type4: retention changed and newly retained ancestry reaches the sole final Pareto result
